## 1、**DC03PE01**计算升序直接插入排序中元素移动的次数

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
int conflictsOfInsertSort(RcdSqList* L)
{ 
    int result = 0;
    int i, j;
    for (i = 1; i < L->length; ++i)
    {
        if (L->rcd[i + 1].key < L->rcd[i].key)
        { 
            L->rcd[0] = L->rcd[i + 1];

            j = i + 1;
            do {
                j--;
                L->rcd[j + 1] = L->rcd[j];
                result++;
            } while (L->rcd[0].key < L->rcd[j - 1].key); 
            L->rcd[j] = L->rcd[0];
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

## 2、**DC03PE06**改进冒泡排序算法

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
void BubbleSort(RcdSqList2 &L) 
{ // Add your code here
int len=L.length;
int change=0,end=len;
//printf("%d",len);


while (end>0) {
    change=0;

    for (int i = 1; i <end ; i++) {
            if (GT(L.rcd[i],L.rcd[i+1])) {
                Swap(L.rcd[i],L.rcd[i+1]);
                change=i;
            }
    }

    end=change;
}

}
```

## 3、**DC03PE23**计数排序算法

```
#include "allinclude.h"  //DO NOT edit this line
void CountSort(RcdSqList2 &L)  
{ // Add your code here
    int len=L.length;
    int c[len+1];

    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        c[i]=0;
        int temp=L.rcd[i].key;
        for (int u =1 ; u <= len; u++) {
            if (u!=i&&L.rcd[u].key<temp) {
                c[i]++;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 1; i <= len; i++) {
        printf("%d ",c[i]);
    }
    printf("\n");

    for (int i = 1; i < len; i++) {
        int k=i;
        for (int u = i+1; u <= len; u++) {
            if (c[k]>c[u]) k=u;
        }
        int temp=c[k];
        c[k]=c[i];
        c[i]=temp;
        int temp1=L.rcd[k].key;
        L.rcd[k].key=L.rcd[i].key;
        L.rcd[i].key=temp1;
    }
}
```
